items.statement: Management confirms Rs 2,500 crore revenue target for FY26 remains on track
items.quote: Yes, we are on track towards that.

items.statement: Board approved Rs 125 crore capex for new PPF line of 300 lakh sq ft per annum, commercial production expected by Q2 FY26
items.quote: To meet future demand, the board has approved Rs. 125 crore in capital expenditure to establish a new PPF line with a capacity of 300 lakh square feet per annum, which is expected to commence commercial production by Q2 FY '2 6.

items.statement: New PPF line capacity 300 lakh sq ft per annum; existing lines running at optimal capacity; debottlenecking planned before new line comes on stream
items.quote: The decision to take this line was primarily because our lines were running at optimal capacity and we have introduced complete range of products like PPF Plus, Premium, Titanium , Matte, Black and White.

items.statement: New PPF line expected to generate Rs 350 crore revenue initially, scaling to Rs 450 crore at full capacity over 2-3 years
items.quote: Yes, it is the same capacity , same line. So, we expect the same revenues of Rs. 350 crores, but that takes like first year it goes with a certain kind of capacity utilization, and two to three years it will go to full. So, that's what the expectation is. So, full scale , it will go to around Rs. 450 crore.

items.statement: PPF demand growing globally at 6.5% CAGR 2024-2030; India penetration increased from 0.5% to 1.5%; SCF demand recovered after inventory rationalization
items.quote: So, if you see those markets that's growing, that is expected to grow at a CAGR of 6.5% from 2024 to 2030. So, we expect a strong growth in overall PPF business.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA Rs 321.1 crore up 19.2% YoY; Q4 EBITDA Rs 89.7 crore up 27.5% YoY; IPD margin pressure partially offset PPF and SCF growth
items.quote: For the full year, EBITDA stood at Rs. 321.1 crore, up by 19.2% year-on-year basis. However, this growth was partially offset by lower volume and margin pressure in the IPD business.

items.statement: PPF revenue 3x growth in Q4 FY24 vs Q4 FY23; SCF surged 67% in Q4; IPD steady growth in shrink/specialty offset by commodity/packaging decline
items.quote: The PPF business achieved 3x revenue growth in Q4 FY '24 compared to Q4 FY '23. We foresee strong traction in both international and domestic markets.

items.statement: GAS franchise stores doubled from 65 to 126; OEM volumes growing from 100-200 to 400-500 units; new architectural team and expats added globally
items.quote: We have like 2 weeks back , if I am not wrong, we launched, we made 4 Garware Application Studios, 3 in Lucknow, 1 in Kanpur, and in next 2 months there is a plan to open 6 to 8 Garware Application Studios.

items.statement: 78% of FY24 revenue from exports; 89% from value-added films; growth across USA, Europe, Russia, China, Far East, Middle East
items.quote: Approximately 78% of our revenue in FY '24 came from export and around 89% from value-added films. This positioning us for superior growth within the industry.

items.statement: Working capital cycle at 8 days for FY24; zero net debt with cash reserve of Rs 388 crore
items.quote: Additionally, our effective working capital management practices have kept our working cycle at just 8 days for FY '24. This reflects our ongoing commitment to operational excellence and efficient cash flow management.

items.statement: Zero net debt as of FY24 with healthy cash reserve of Rs 388 crore
items.quote: I am pleased to report that beyond our impressive quarterly growth, we have maintained an exceptionally strong financial position, our balance sheet w as zero net debt and a healthy cash reserve of Rs. 388 crore.

items.statement: FY24 ROCE 21.08% and ROE 15.87% excluding revaluation reserve; PAT Rs 203.3 crore up 22.4% YoY
items.quote: This year, we achieved an impressive ROCE of 21.08% and ROE of 15.87%, excluding the revaluation reserve. These figures demonstrate our efficient utilization of funds generated by our business operations.

items.statement: Titanium PPF launched as premium GAS-exclusive product with lifetime warranty; full product range from basic to top-tier with 3-8 year and lifetime warranties
items.quote: So, with these basis like top of the top products which comes with all competitor, so with launch of this product, we have a complete range from the very basic level to the top of the top range.

items.statement: Not affected by Xpel's guidance cut; distributed sales across multiple channels and regions including USA, Europe, Russia, China, Far East, Middle East
items.quote: So, to answer your first question, like guidance given by a particular Company is for a particular market and their results, I believe, are impacted by that. But if you compare our results was because we are talking of the same quarters. So, you can see the difference that we are not at all affected by whatever is given by a particular Company.

items.statement: IPD segment recovery expected but not as strong; seasonal shrink business; commodity/packaging stabilization showing upward movement
items.quote: And overall, on IPD segment also, we are expecting a bounce back, but not as strong like it will jump from, but definitely from the level of FY '24, this year we are seeing a good momentum as we go on into that business.

items.statement: FY26 revenue guidance maintained at Rs 2,500 crore with stable EBITDA margins
items.quote: So, we are expecting like overall to go, to cross like Rs. 2,000 crores for sure and the guidance about FY '26 which we maintain around Rs. 2,500 crores.

items.statement: FY26 revenue guidance of Rs 2,500 crore and stable EBITDA margins reaffirmed
items.quote: Yes, we continue, we maintain that guideline for FY '26, and also the margins, I mean, EBITDA margins are going to be stable at that number.

items.statement: Rs 125 crore capex planned for new PPF line in FY25
items.quote: We have this CAPEX plan what we discuss PPF almost Rs. 125 crores. This year we need to spend, ' 24-'25.

items.statement: New PPF line to reach full utilization in 2-3 years, targeting Rs 450 crore revenue at full scale
items.quote: So, that's what the expectation is. So, full scale , it will go to around Rs. 450 crore.

items.statement: Fungible capacity and debottlenecking provide headroom for 20-30% growth before new PPF line commissioning
items.quote: we have headroom to grow both in PPF and sun control before the new line, until the time the new PPF line is commissioned

items.statement: PPF orders exist for coming months; quarterly fluctuations due to inventory dispatch timing and seasonality
items.quote: what happens sometimes, more inventory goes. I mean, the orders are there for coming months

items.statement: PPF demand seasonal with Q2-Q3 strength; sun control films seasonal with Q1-Q2 peak; architectural segment targeting >50% growth in FY25
items.quote: And in PPF typically we have seen Q2 and Q3, people tend to buy more because then the focus shifts towards PPF. And in Q1 and Q2, the focus shifts towards sun control.

items.statement: White label vs own brand mix shifted to 60-40 (white label:own) from typical 50-50 due to large customer orders
items.quote: Typically, we keep it 50-50, but we saw a big jump from some big players. So, we can say it's a 60-40. Like 60% towards white box and 40% towards us.

items.statement: IPD division gross margin fell from 18.48% in FY23 to 17.88% in FY24 due to overcapacity; expected to improve above FY23 levels
items.quote: So, on an operations basis, like gross margin was around 18.48%, which dropped to 17.88% in FY '24, right? But that is like a mix of product mix makes lot of changes in that.

items.statement: IPD margin recovery gains will flow directly to company profitability, not increased marketing spend
items.quote: No, no, actually in marketing spend, we have already kind of budgeted. So, whatever gain from IPD side will add to the value or directly to the Company.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis caused marginal freight cost increase and 10-15 day lead time extension; no financial performance impact
items.quote: There is a freight cost increase, but that is very minimal. It is not like we experienced in 2021 -22 when COVID was there. So, there is a marginal increase and lead time has increased by 10 to 15 days.

items.statement: Top 10 white label customers drive majority volumes; long tail of smaller customers
items.quote: So, there would be a long tail of customers , but if I say like equally or distribution will be like around 10 customers who will be like pretty with the volumes, with the higher volumes.

items.statement: 46% of total revenue from North America; minimal China exposure; continued strong momentum in US market despite peer warnings
items.quote: See, overall, our sales, as we said, 46% of our total business is coming from North America, right. So, we can't say that we are not dependent.

items.statement: Proactive supply management to mitigate 10-15 day lead time increase from Red Sea routing
items.quote: So, we have proactively started supplying to the customers so that they do not go out of the product.

items.statement: Rs 388 crore cash on hand; no buyback or dividend hike plans in immediate term; evaluating inorganic growth opportunities
items.quote: Sir, actually what you said is right. We have cash of Rs. 388 crores on hand. So, what we are planning is we have this CAPEX plan what we discuss PPF almost Rs. 125 crores.

items.statement: Dividend maintained at Rs 10; no immediate plans for buyback or dividend increase despite cash accumulation
items.quote: As of now , we don't have any plans for buybacks , and also any dividend hikes in the immediate term.

items.statement: Internal team restructured with dedicated architectural films division to drive >50% segment growth
items.quote: Honestly, this is an internal division to create a big focus towards architectural segment. Like I said, we had yesterday also one conference of the West regio n.

items.statement: New lamination line operating at 60-80% utilization in recent months
items.quote: So, new lamination line of like if you talk of recent months , that is close to , I can say, 60% to 80% it's going.

items.statement: PPG paint-integrated protection film technology not commercially viable; no market threat to PPF business
items.quote: As of now, there is no paint technology which can be directly applied to that. So, there was some, like, I would say, as of now it is not clarified by the sources like what it is.

items.statement: Wide product portfolio across segments offsets single-segment weakness seen by competitors like Xpel
items.quote: However, there were concerns on, I could see even the Tesla's commentary, and then Xpel commentary, then some other people have these things, but the good thing about us like we are a very wide range of products and they make up for one another.

items.statement: No regulatory issues mentioned; business model compliant across geographies
items.quote: We have noted your point, sir. We will come back to you.

items.statement: Management targets a return to long-term growth trend in FY25, ambition of 10-15% revenue growth
items.quote: Yes. So usually, we don't give like specific guidance, but I mean, that's certainly our kind of ambition or target.

items.statement: FY25 capex budget broadly in line with previous year, more than INR100 crore including Chennai plant and brownfield expansions
items.quote: But for the company as a whole, the capex budget, it's not 100% final yet and it keeps changing over the year. It is broadly in line with the previous year's number, which is more than INR100 crore.

items.statement: Chennai greenfield facility on long-term lease near Chennai, hopes to start this calendar year and certainly this financial year
items.quote: We are closely evaluating a land parcel on a long-term lease strategically located near Chennai. The location would be near major industrial hubs and offer easy access to core markets and logistical advantages.

items.statement: Chennai plant is one line out of ~20 lines company-wide, revenue impact expected from next financial year
items.quote: I haven't worked it out, but it's just one line. And we have, as a company, about 20 lines. So it's not going to be a very big increase in the capacity.

items.statement: Overall capacity utilization approximately 75% to 80%
items.quote: So we don't give the breakup unit wise, but let's say, over all, our utilization level is approximately 75% to 80%.

items.statement: Flexible packaging utilization still low after new line added mid-late last year, no major capex planned for next year
items.quote: So for the flexible, we just added the line middle or late last year. So the utilization is still low. And there is no major capex planned for the next year at least.

items.statement: Q4 margin improvement driven largely by raw material price decline and product mix improvement
items.quote: No, it's largely driven by RM improvement, which is a result of RM price change, but also a result of product mix improvement, which shows up in better RM contribution.

items.statement: FY24 domestic demand subdued, anticipating rebound in coming fiscal, FMCG volume growth marginal last 3 years
items.quote: Despite the high base effect from the previous year and reduced demand in select end user industries affecting our growth in FY24, we remain optimistic about the market trend and anticipate a rebound in domestic demand in the coming fiscal.

items.statement: Paper packaging volume growth very low single digit in FY24, flexible packaging growth higher
items.quote: Yes. So for this year, it's been very low single digit. And even for the quarter, it's been low single-digit only.

items.statement: Flexible packaging share growing but paperboard also growing, margin stable on upward trajectory despite mix shift
items.quote: So despite the flexible having increased already quite a lot over the last few years, the margin has been fairly stable, I mean, it's on an upward trajectory only.

items.statement: Creative Packaging cracked several new customers in electronics, consumer products, cosmetics segments, growth estimated in high double digits
items.quote: There were a few customers where we were doing very small value of like trial order business where we have cracked major orders starting this season now.

items.statement: Creative Packaging ambition to become triple-digit crore revenue business, focused on high value-added premium products
items.quote: As we've said in the past, our goal or ambition with Creative is to turn this into a triple-digit crore revenue business.

items.statement: Exports 32-33% of revenue in FY24, grown substantially over several years, further room for growth
items.quote: We put out for the first time in the deck that 32%, 33% of our revenues came from exports this year.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis increasing freight costs and lead times, impacting export margins and customer interest
items.quote: And they do impact our growth as well as our margin, no doubt, because when the shipping cost goes up dramatically, then you are competing with a local supplier, and he suddenly is much more favourable.

items.statement: Recycled board prices doubled at peak, now slightly above pre-COVID; virgin board up ~60% at peak, largely clawed back
items.quote: Basically, recycled board at the peak had doubled. And by now, it's still a little higher than it was before COVID, but not by a whole lot. So it's really come down a lot.

items.statement: Net working capital days around 80-85 days including Red Sea crisis impact since November
items.quote: No. This is including the effect of this Red Sea crisis. So this crisis has been on since November. So there's nothing, but it's all there in our numbers.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of INR22 per share, 24th consecutive year of uninterrupted dividend payout
items.quote: I'm pleased to announce that our Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of INR22 per share. This marks the 24th consecutive year of uninterrupted dividend payout.

items.statement: Mr. Ashish Razdan joined as Additional Director/Non-Executive Independent Director with expertise in M&A and private equity
items.quote: Further, we are pleased to announce that Mr. Ashish Razdan has joined us as an Additional Director/Non-Executive Independent Director, thereby strengthening our Board.

items.statement: FY24 consolidated revenue INR1,541 crore (+5%), EBITDA INR251 crore (+7%), margin 16.3%, Cash PAT INR206 crore
items.quote: In FY24, our consolidated revenues rose by 5% to INR1,541 crore, supported by export initiatives and healthy contributions from the flexible segment. EBITDA grew by 7% to INR251 crore, translating into a margin of 16.3%.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 consolidated revenue crossed INR400 crore, EBITDA INR70 crore, margin 17.6%, Cash PAT INR57 crore
items.quote: In Q4, consolidated revenues crossed INR400 crore, with EBITDA reaching INR70 crore, reflecting strong margins of 17.6%, respectively.

items.statement: Government rules on packaging getting more stringent, recycled content norms coming, Europe planning tax on non-sustainable packaging
items.quote: The rules and norms are getting more stringent. And globally also, this is the case like in Europe now in coming years, there's going to be tax on non-sustainable packaging.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis a big hindrance to export growth, higher freight costs reduce competitiveness vs local suppliers
items.quote: Yes, certainly, these kind of disruptions are a huge headache and long-term deterrent for customers to do business with foreign geographies.

items.statement: Innofilms line stabilized on quality, making commercial supply of recyclable innovative packaging, no longer a P&L drag
items.quote: We are now more or less stabilized in terms of the film quality. And we are actually making commercial supply for certain customers of ours when it comes to the recyclable innovative packaging.

items.statement: Innofilms line also used for regular films when not making high value-add film, R&D focused on niche innovative applications
items.quote: In the time that it's not manufacturing the high value-add film, we are using it for other purposes like the regular films.

items.statement: Very few competitors in India and globally doing mono-material sustainable flexible packaging due to technical complexity
items.quote: There are very few others in the market who are doing this. Again, I won't talk about specific companies on this platform, but there are not many in India and also not that many around the world.

items.statement: New Independent Director brings M&A and private equity expertise as company continues to expand
items.quote: He brings expertise in corporate transactions, including mergers and acquisitions and private equity.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance for FY25 is 14% to 17%
items.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain within the 14% to 17% band for the next financial year.

items.statement: First phase of new Tarapur plant expected by end of Q2 FY25; full plant by end of CY2025
items.quote: Our CAPEX plan is progressing well and remains on track with the first phase expected to be completed by the end of Q2 FY25.

items.statement: Current plants operating at 90-95% utilization; outsourcing increased to meet demand
items.quote: I will not like to put any numbers again because I would not like to give a number guidance, but yes, we are operating at 90% plus capacity on our plants currently and it is impossible in a chemical plant to work at 100%.

items.statement: Demand recovery driven by volume growth in Asia and RoW markets; Europe stagnant
items.quote: The inventory destocking phase, which had a significant headwind, finally came to an end leading to a notable recovery in demand, particularly from the Asia region.

items.statement: Prices bottomed out after 20-40% decline across products; no price rise seen yet
items.quote: We have seen prices go down from a range of about 20% to 40% from product to product.

items.statement: Gross margin improved to ~53% in FY24 from 50% in FY23; expected to be maintained
items.quote: So gross margin is probably reverse of that, about 53% as compared to 50% last year. So, it's improved in the current year and going forward, we expect that this sort of margin will be maintained.

items.statement: 8 product filings in EU since May 2022; approvals delayed due to backlog and additional studies
items.quote: Totally 8 products have been filed for.

items.statement: Product basket widened to ~30 APIs; top-10 product share declining to derisk portfolio
items.quote: We are now doing as a basket of close to about 30 odd APIs and we are in the process of getting these done pretty well. And our market share from our top 10 products gradually has been decreasing over the last 3 years, which was that sales is now coming from a wider basket.

items.statement: Europe sales are for re-export; shifting to direct registrations in RoW and EU markets
items.quote: So, all our customers in Europe are buying it for re-export. Now, as the domestic presence grows internationally , buying in Europe and exporting to these countries is gradually going to reduce.

items.statement: Intense competition from Chinese capacity additions and dumping since Feb 2023
items.quote: Chinese were out of the market for a long time and came back after all controls were relaxed in February last year and they started dumping, so competition is very intense right now.

items.statement: Power and fuel cost increased Rs 4.5 crore; processing charges up Rs 2 crore (mainly subsidiary)
items.quote: So out of the let's say about Rs. 15 crores increase, Rs. 4.5 crores is just cost of power and fuel. About Rs. 2 crores is cost of processing charges, but that's mainly to our subsidiary.

items.statement: Outsourcing cost rose from Rs 3.5 crore to Rs 5.6 crore to meet incremental demand
items.quote: Our total cost as compared to the earlier financial year has gone up from about Rs. 3.5 crores to about Rs. 5.6 crores.

items.statement: Project expenses capitalized, not charged to P&L; no project cost reflected in P&L yet
items.quote: Project expenses cannot be charged to P&L, they have to be capitalized. So, nothing on the project is getting reflected on the P&L yet.

items.statement: Employee cost up Rs 8 crore (20%) due to salary hikes and hiring for volume growth
items.quote: So we have seen it to go up from roughly about Rs. 37 crores to about 45 crores, it's gone up. So that's about an Rs. 8 crore increase, which is about 20%.

items.statement: EU filings take 15-18 months normally; now delayed by backlog and extra studies (genotoxicity)
items.quote: But now EU has, there are two issues which have taken place due to COVID, there has been a backlog which has been built up and they are also asking for numerous other additional studies to be conducted, like genotoxicity and other studies to be conducted , w hich is taking time

items.statement: No visibility on when pricing will recover; margins to stay depressed until prices rise
items.quote: We haven't seen the price rise occurring yet, except for in a couple of isolated products. As a gradual rule, the price increase has still not taken place, but we see that the bottom of the bell curve is achieved.

items.statement: US market entry ~3 years away; requires validation batches, filing, FDA inspection
items.quote: For the US market, there is nothing which can be done because we have to ready the plant. We have to make the validation batches. We have to do the filing. We have to get somebody applying to trigger the inspection. So manufacture, then create the database for that which takes a year, then do the filing. So it's basically a 2-to-3 years process.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of minimum 25% for FY25, implying INR2,400 crores revenue
items.quote: That is our commitment to the clients, minimum commitment. So we have to grow at that level to -- so given what we have done in quarter 4, INR6 00 crores, INR2,400 crores is given for the current financial year

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of INR3,000+ crores for FY25
items.quote: So we are looking at INR3,000 plus crores as we stand today. It will be reviewed obviously with comparison to the revenues done in the first half year of the current financial year.

items.statement: EBIT margin guidance of 12% to 12.5% for FY25
items.quote: So 12% to 12.5% is what our guidance I can give you. But if something better happens, we should all be happy.

items.statement: Net debt free by end of FY25
items.quote: There is no doubt that we'll be net debt free by the end of current financial year.

items.statement: Capex guidance of INR55 crores for FY25
items.quote: We believe that the current year, the approval from the Board taken is approximately INR55 crores and we should be at that level only.

items.statement: Finance cost reduction of 100+ basis points from H2 FY25
items.quote: However, going forward from H2 current financial year, we believe the finance cost to reduce by active 100 basis points or more.

items.statement: Standalone order book of INR9,011 crores as of March 31, 2024 (69% public, 31% private)
items.quote: Order book on stand-alone basis stood at INR9,011 crores as on 31st March '24. Public sector accounts for 69% while private sector accounts for 31% of the total order book.

items.statement: MHADA project order book share INR4,500+ crores plus escalation (~INR5,500 crores), INR1,500 crores recognized
items.quote: So MHADA project, the order book considered as on 3 1st March, our share in the project is INR4,500 crores plus escalation, which works out to maybe INR5,500 crores or so. At the moment, the order book recognized is close to INR1, 500

items.statement: CIDCO backlog of INR3,200 crores, targeting INR600 crores execution in FY25
items.quote: CIDCO backlog is about INR3,200 crores. And we have d one about INR375 crores in the last financial year. We look to do about INR600 crores i n the current financial year

items.statement: BDD project single contract of INR12,000 crores, INR800 crores land made available in current quarter
items.quote: So BDD is a single contract of INR12,000 crores. So we only had that order book for which land is made available. So in the current quarter, we will add about INR800 crores of land, which has been made available to Capacit'e on a stand-alone basis.

items.statement: Strong bid pipeline of INR3-4 lakh crores per year for next 5 years across public and private sectors
items.quote: Now bid pipeline, I can usually tell you that there will be an opportunity of more than 3 lakh crores to 4 lakh crores per year for the next 5 years if the construction or infrastructure momentum, which has been going on is not tampered with.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 19.8% vs 19.1% YoY; FY24 EBITDA margin 18.5% vs 20% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin for FY '24 stood at 18.5% as compared to 20% in FY '23.

items.statement: FY24 EBIT margin 13% vs 12.4% YoY; Q4 FY24 EBIT margin 16.2% vs 13% YoY
items.quote: The EBIT margin for FY '24 stood at 13% as compared to 12.4% for full year financial year '23.

items.statement: Targeting EBIT margin expansion on existing order book with 25% revenue growth
items.quote: We believe that if the revenue grows significantly, let's say, by 25% year-on-year, there will be a fair chance of opportunity for the EBIT ma rgin to grow on the existing order book itself

items.statement: FY24 capex INR45.11 crores; FY25 capex guided at INR55 crores with focus on asset rotation
items.quote: So the capex, which was done in last financial year, '24 was INR45.11 crores. We believe that the current year, the approval from the Board taken is approximately INR55 crores and we should be at that level only.

items.statement: Restricting projects to 35-36 to maintain management bandwidth, each targeting INR10 crores/month revenue
items.quote: We have guided that over the ne xt 2 years, we would like to restrict that number of projects to 35, 36. Now 35, 36 projects a nd if each project, minimum gives INR10 crores revenue that translates into a INR350 crores revenue per

items.statement: Targeting net working capital reduction of ~20 days in FY25, returning to historical 96-97 days in 4-5 quarters
items.quote: And we do believe that there is a strong case for a reduction in the net working capital by nearly 20 days in the current financial year.

items.statement: Net debt INR69 crores (0.05x debt/equity) in FY24; gross debt INR326 crores vs INR370 crores YoY
items.quote: Gross debt stood at INR326 crores as compared to INR370 crores Net debt for the year stood at INR69 crores with net debt to equity at 0.05x.

items.statement: Finance cost Q4 FY24 INR22.15 crores vs Q3 INR25.61 crores; interest on client advances to drop to INR1-1.5 crores in FY25
items.quote: And last year, that cost was INR7.92 crores. We bel ieve that cost should come down to about INR1 crores or 1.50 crores in the current financial year

items.statement: Public-private order mix to remain ~70-30; selective bidding in private sector with existing quality clients
items.quote: So more or less, the order bifurcation between public sector and private sector would remain 70-30.

items.statement: Executing 13 data centers for defense; bid for INR700 crores data center with L&T; technical tie-up for Tier 3/4 data centers
items.quote: The company has bid for a INR700 crores data center and we expect the opening soon after elections. And hopefully, it was a tender on which three parties, including L&T & Capacit'e were qualified.

items.statement: Pre-qualified for Adani Dharavi project; completing first government hospital by Aug-Sep 2024 to strengthen healthcare qualifications
items.quote: We will be completing our first government hospital by August-September this year, which will further strengthen our qualifications to build across India, for all government hospital projects.

items.statement: Quarterly execution run rate INR600-700 crores; Q2 FY25 may dip to INR550-600 crores due to monsoon
items.quote: So INR600 crores is given. What I mentioned is that monsoon period, generally, given the summers, which we have had, we expect a strong monsoon as well, all right?

items.statement: MHADA revenue FY24 INR250 crores (Q4 INR70 crores); targeting INR350 crores in FY25
items.quote: So at the moment, given the work front available, w e are looking at about INR350 crores

items.statement: CIDCO revenue FY24 INR372 crores; targeting INR600 crores in FY25
items.quote: We do believe that the revenue to be done in the current financial year will be somewhere close to INR600 crores.

items.statement: MCGC tenders migrated from BoQ to EPC, providing better margin opportunities for EPC contractors
items.quote: And now even MCGM, which was earlier, BoQ tenders have now migrated to EPC. Th at gives us better opportunity to companies like ours to improve upon the efficiencie s of engineering and thereby make a better

items.statement: Labor shortage across industry (L&T short 50-60k, Tata Projects also short); labor not organized, shifts for small pay increase
items.quote: You must have seen L&T saying that they are short by 50,000, 60,000 labor. Tata Projects is also short of labor. So every company i s struggling to get adequate number of workmen at the project site

items.statement: Raised INR200 crores via QIP in Q4 FY24; capital deployed to strengthen execution across projects
items.quote: Successfully raised INR200 crores by qualified institutional placement in Q4 FY '24. The raised capital is being strategically deployed to fuel our future growth and fortify our operational capabilities.

items.statement: No top/second level management changes needed; project teams will add with project count increase
items.quote: Sir, managerial changes at the top level and the se cond level are not required. Revenue comes from project sites

items.statement: Implant business targets $16 million revenue in FY25 ($8M US, $8M OUS) and aims for $100M in 5 years
items.quote: Yes, that's right. So, we're looking at about $16 million this year with $8 million in the U.S. and $8 million in OUS. That's correct.

items.statement: Implant business targets COGS reduction to 50-55% by end of FY25 from current 80%+
items.quote: Looking at the Pillar 2 which is on the COGS reduction, we are looking to end the year about at approximately COGS up about 50%-55%, which is right now upwards of 80%.

items.statement: Implant business expects 30% COGS reduction by end of FY25
items.quote: So, by the last quarter, you would have seen that COGS going down by about 30%.

items.quote: However, this was actually being offset by better realization from INR5.39 per piece to INR5.63 per piece.

items.statement: ROE 13.2%, ROCE 17.5% for FY24

items.statement: Domestic OEM demand subdued due to customer reorganization; unable to provide guidance, targeting maintenance of FY24 levels

items.statement: Disney license agreement tenure is 2 years; royalty terms not disclosed

name: Krishna Defence and Allied Industries Limited

items.statement: Brownfield expansion capex of ₹15-20 crores to double manufacturing capacity

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 14.51% in FY24 from 13.91% in FY23

items.quote: EBITDA margins have also increased to 15.08% in H2 FY'24 against 12.76% in H2 FY'23 thereby showing a jump of 232 basis points.

items.statement: Expected revenue mix: bulb bars ~50%, weld consumables 15-20%, Bukhari 15-20%, others ~10%
items.quote: We expect if you just ask a broad thing, we expect bulb bars to grow about close to 50 odd percent of our revenues, somewhere in that range followed by weld consumables about close to 15% to 20%. items.statement: 100% revenue from government/defence entities except L&T
items.quote: 100%. Except if you consider L&T, not a government that is there. So that percentage will vary. But majority of our business comes from the defence.

items.statement: Funds raised used for ₹15-20 crores capex and ₹35-40 crores working capital
items.quote: Yeah, so as mentioned, while we had done the fundraise, we were looking to do about close to ₹15 crores to ₹20 crores towards CapEx, and the remaining about ₹35 crores to ₹40 crores towards working capital because of the order flow that we were anticipating earlier.

items.statement: Hired 3-4 middle management people in last 4 months for execution

items.statement: Plan to increase WAVEOPTIX stake to ~51% in next 6 months
items.quote: In the next six months, we should be upping our stake to about close to 51%.

items.quote: We plan to we should close that very soon. I have not put on timeline to it, but literally very, very soon because we are starting trials next month. And in terms of the joint venture, we definitely will be 51% or more.

items.statement: Bulb bar capacity: current 2,000-2,500 tons/year, expanding to ~4,000 tons/year
items.quote: And with the capacity expansion, we should be able to achieve a number of close to 4,000 tons.

items.statement: No royalty for DRDO products supplied to Indian defence forces; royalty only for exports
items.quote: As per the new DAP policy or since 2020, there is no royalty to be paid as long as the goods are supplied for Indian defence forces. If we are to export it, then there would be a portion of royalty. But currently, there is none.

items.statement: Indian Navy plans to grow fleet from 135 to 175 ships by 2030
items.quote: We have a 135 ships that are there, which has to be upgraded to 175. items.statement: ₹88 crore order received April 3rd, execution over 8 months starting next month
items.quote: The execution will start as early as next month, but not all of will be executed by end of Q2 that is there. It will spill over to Q3, but we have to do it in about eight months' time.

items.statement: Composite doors/hatches target ₹50-100 crores revenue at full stream
items.quote: We think that we could clock a revenue about ₹50 crores to ₹100 crores once we are in full stream per se. But since this is a new product, it will grow gradually. items.statement: Current gross block ~₹14 crores, ₹11+ crores for defence
items.quote: Our total block is around ₹14 CR, and out of that ₹11 CR plus is for the defence.

items.statement: 80-90% of capital employed deployed in defence business
items.quote: About 80% to 90% of capital is deployed for the defence business, and the remainder is for the dairy business.

items.statement: Current capacity utilisation ~80%, new facility approval simpler for approved player
items.quote: So currently, we're about close to 80% capacity, and hence we are up augmenting our capacity to be doubled. These facilities that come up also need to go through the whole process, but they are much simpler for an already approved player unlike a new player coming in.

items.statement: WAVEOPTIX opportunity: 1,000-2,000 systems at ₹9 lakh each after successful 40-system trial
items.quote: We expect, that they will be upping their order to about 1,000 to 2,000 systems, because that is what the requirement or probably much more than that.

items.statement: New products under development for BARC, ISRO, Planys ROVs, composite doors
items.quote: Since we successfully developed weld consumables for very complex chemistry for critical platforms, we are now being approached by other organisations like BARC and ISRO for development of another their group was very specific weld consumables, which they are currently imported. So these are all under development right now, and we are hopeful of pulling that through.

items.statement: Aspire to reach 20% EBITDA margin but expect to land between current 15% and 20%
items.quote: So I think, the 20% was what we would aspire to reach that is there. But the reality will -- because the growth in numbers and revenues are there. items.statement: Targets 15-20% topline growth in FY25
items.quote: So, as Mr. Upasani just mentioned, we are looking out for a 15 % to 20% growth in the topline in the coming year.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA margin above 10% for FY25
items.quote: So, the EBITDA margin that we expect is more than 10% of EBITDA that we expect with this increasing topline. So, 10% of EBITDA is what we are targeting in the year end.

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin target of 15-20% over 3-5 years
items.quote: According to what steps I have taken right now, the sustainable EBITDA margin will be about 15% to 20% is what we are into target for.

items.quote: Once the approval in place, we will be investing this money to increase the hospital accommodation picture.

items.quote: this year we will be screening not towards 1000 clinics, but we will be having more 50 to 60 franchise clinics in this coming whole year because we will be consolidating

items.statement: Hospital EBITDA margin 20-30% unallocated; clinic EBITDA margin 30-40% unallocated
items.quote: if at all we talk about the hospital as such, the EBITDA margins that we get is about 20 % to 30% while if at all we don't allocate the total expenses, the annual expenses on the clinics, the unallocated expenses , I am talking about, then the EBITDA of the clinics also reaches to about 30% to 40%.

items.statement: Current consolidated EBITDA margin ~4.5% (Rs 4.5 cr on Rs 99.33 cr revenue)
items.quote: EBITDA excluding other income was Rs. 4.50 crores in FY24 as again st Rs. 7.86 crore in FY23.

items.statement: In-house food production at UV Ayurgen to cut purchase cost 20-30%
items.quote: the food products purchase that we used to go ahead with, the whole purchase cost will reduce down by about 20 % to 30% due to this acquisition

items.quote: There were two -three reasons to this, one was the acquisition of the U V Ayurgen Factory as well as Dynamic, the wholly owned subsidiary that you can see.

items.quote: We have been empaneled with more than 35 insurance companies to offer cashless facility at our hospital.

items.statement: Mission 2025 target of 1,000 clinics delayed to 3-4 years; presentation outdated
items.quote: No, that will be a bit delayed, but I am sure I will be able to reach that in the next 3 to 4 years.

items.quote: I am planning to scale up this Rs. 14 crores, Rs. 15 crores odd budget to about Rs. 18 to Rs. 20 crores budget for marketing

items.quote: effectively this Rs. 27 crores, we are planning to reduce it down to about Rs. 22-Rs. 23 crores

items.quote: Concurrently, the Ayurveda hospital market is projected to reach about US $ 3.2 by 2030.

items.quote: The reason for this was increase in the human resource that we had planned to get more patients inside and hence the whole human resource cost had increased and that led to reduction in the EBITDA, but the action has already been implemented for it.

items.quote: There is a demand for at least for a minimum three to five years, the demand will persist.

items.statement: Price variation clause in government contracts covers raw material inflation; private orders locked in with same-day raw material booking

items.quote: That capacity, that is revenue. You are asking about the rev enue. It should be more than INR600 crores when the full capacity

items.quote: When we complete our new expansion project, then we will be comparing ourselves with DHL and other companies. Looking more bigger companies.

items.quote: Actually, last year, actually we planned for a minimum of 20 - 25% growth. And when there was a flo od in December, our revenue got a minimum of INR10 crores to INR15

items.quote: Our endeavor in the medium term is, you know, as I'd indicated to some other participant was that we want to get to a consistent double-digit revenue growth.

items.quote: We have refrained from price increases now for the almost five quarters or a little more, maybe six quarters now. So middle of, let's say, second half of '22, '23.

items.statement: Demand improved from January to March but sustainability unclear; optimistic medium term

items.quote: They will cumulatively account for almost something like 40% of our turnover.

items.quote: The industry growth estimates based on various inputs that we get, but I mean, nominally speaking, it should be GDP growth plus the inflation, minimal, and that works out to almost low-double digits in those lines.

items.statement: India sugar production estimated at 323 LMT for 2023-24 season; closing stock ~90 LMT by Sep 2024 vs 2.5 months consumption norm

items.statement: No volume or revenue guidance given; FY25 cane planting dipped in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka okay, AP marginal dip

items.statement: Distillery price realization Q4 INR64.49/litre vs INR62.56/litre YoY
items.quote: As far as price realization is concerned, the price realization in Q4 is INR64.49 per litre against pr evious year realization of INR62.56 per litre

items.quote: Retail overall this year was about 28% of our sale in terms of volume, the value-added portion of that, we will aspire to grow aggressively because it's a sterilization of retail over the coming year.

items.quote: We are always open to alliances for value creation and if we have any news at all we'll make appropriate intimations, but there's no news to discuss at this point in time.

items.quote: Despite this, led by all the profitability measures as explained before, Lifestyle brands posted highest ever EBITDA at INR1,284 crores, growing 17% Y-o-Y. Margin expanded by 300 basis points to reach 19.6% this fiscal.

items.statement: Pantaloons Q4 EBITDA margin grew 270 basis points to 10.4%.
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the business grew by 270 basis points to reach 10.4%.

items.statement: Market conditions remained largely unchanged with continued sluggishness in discretionary spending; January and February particularly affected by reduction in weddings and delayed winter onset.

items.statement: Contribution from businesses other than Lifestyle and Pantaloons increased from ~16% to ~25% of overall sales in FY24.

items.statement: Pantaloons private label mix improved by 140 basis points in FY24 led by design aesthetics and addition of labels and categories.
items.quote: This fiscal, private label mix improved by 140 basis points led by significant improvement in design aesthetics and addition to labels and categories.

items.statement: Ethnic portfolio annual revenue run rate INR2,000 crores plus, growing rapidly led by network expansion, same store sales growth and category extensions.
items.quote: This portfolio now has an annual revenue run rate of INR2,000 crores plus and continue to grow rapidly, led by network expansion, same store sales growth and category extensions.

items.statement: Reebok on path to double revenue in next 3-4 years led by rapid distribution expansion across channels.
items.quote: The brand is on a path to double its revenue in the next 3, 4 years, led by rapid expansion of distribution across channels.

items.statement: StyleUp format economically viable; accelerated expansion expected in H2 FY25 and even faster next year.
items.quote: You will see a more accelerated expansion in this format as we are beginning to get more and more comfortable with the format and its viability. The second half of this year, we'll see more accelerated expansion and perhaps an even faster one next year.

items.statement: Demerger expected to complete by end of Q3 or Q4 FY25; TCNS merger to complete in ~3 months after court AGM on June 5.
items.quote: On demerger, it may be, as you know, we are progressing as per our timeline. We plan to complete this exercise by end of fiscal -- end of Q3 or in last quarter of FY '25.

items.statement: Lifestyle brands ROC without goodwill historically 35-60%, expected to remain at that level.

items.statement: Capacity growth guidance of early double-digits for FY25 and 10-12% YoY for Q1 FY25

items.statement: Revenue environment in Q1 FY25 expected similar to Q1 FY24 on passenger RASK level

items.statement: Firm order for 30 Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft placed recently
items.quote: Further towards our goal of Internationalization, we recently had a landmark development as we placed an order for 30 Firm Airbus A350-900 aircraft.

items.statement: Pending orderbook of nearly 1,000 aircraft to be delivered until 2035

items.statement: Target of 600+ aircraft fleet by end of decade
items.quote: With our target of 600 plus aircraft fleet by the end of this decade in mind, we continue to develop and align people, processes and technology in line with the growing size and scale of IndiGo.

items.statement: FY24 net profit margin 11.9% vs net loss in FY23; Q4 FY24 net margin 10.6% up 4.1 points YoY

items.quote: Moving to the unit cost ex fuel ex forex there is a YoY increase of about 9% mainly due to cost escalations, grounding-related costs and increase in employee costs.

items.statement: ELV portal sold ~37,000 vehicles (21,000 central govt, 15,000 state govt); MMRPL procurement value ~Rs. 250-300 crores; ecosystem development will drive future traction.

items.statement: Management focuses on volume growth rather than matching past peak revenue numbers due to 25-30% price declines in generic products
items.quote: Our first objective is not to match the numbers or surpass the numbers. What we are concentrating on is to increase the volumes of our products.

items.statement: Expect domestic market revival driven by above-normal monsoon forecast; international recovery may take longer but order positions show stability
items.quote: We are more clear that because of the rain forecast, et cetera, the domestic market will revive very quickly. As it revives, we will revive further. International business revival may take some more time

items.statement: Q4 gross margin of 41.7% driven by quick liquidation of high-cost inventory and lower raw material purchase prices; margins expected to sustain if monsoon and pricing remain stable
items.quote: We don't see the price erosion and we expect that these margins will remain.

items.statement: Generic product prices declined 25-30% in FY24; specialty product prices declined only ~2%
items.quote: The prices itself have dropped 25% or so, 25%, 30% in some products, even more maybe but -- so comparing the figures, sales figures itself may not be the true justification.

items.statement: Bhavnagar plant at full production, expecting 100% capacity export in FY25; Tarapur plant ready but revenue delayed to FY26 due to affiliate inventory; Dahej environment clearance expected by end of calendar year
items.quote: We expect that, I think in the last year, we had got -- we sold around 40% or 50% of our capacity we could export but in the current season means current year, we are expecting that 100% of our production capacity will be exported out as far as Bhavnagar plant is concerned.

items.statement: Barrix acquisition consolidated from Dec 15, 2023; contributed INR10-12 crores sales in 105 days; expecting strong year-on-year growth
items.quote: In terms of the sales, it is in the range of about INR10 crores to INR12 crores, which has been consolidated in our books for this 100-day period.

items.statement: Domestic agrochemical demand reasonable despite weather challenges; government support driving normalization in last two quarters; LatAm demand hit by adverse weather and excess supply
items.quote: Despite the challenges, the domestic demand for agrochemical remain relatively reasonable. The government's continued emphasis on agricultural productivity and initiatives to support farmers contributed to overall normalization of agrochemical consumption during the last 2 quarters.

items.statement: Launched 3 herbicides, 1 insecticide, 2 fungicides in FY24; focus on ramping up new product sales; conducting trials for future pipeline products
items.quote: We launched 3 herbicides, 1 insecticide and 2 fungicides in FY '24. Our focus will remain to ramp up the sales of the new products in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Management targets 12% to 15% domestic volume growth in FY25 to offset price declines and grow new products
items.quote: So overall, I'm looking at somewhere around 12% to 15% volume.

items.statement: Aspiration for new products launched in last 2-3 years to contribute 8% to 10% of revenue in FY25 if season is normal
items.quote: Our target is at least not target, I would say our aspiration would be somewhere between 8% to 10%.

items.statement: Next capex cycle estimated at INR250-300 crores to start, funded from internal accruals
items.quote: And the next capital cycle should be in the range of INR250 crores to INR300 crores but we will at least prefer to start with.

items.statement: Maintenance and other capex for FY25 planned at around INR53 crores including INR25 crores for green energy
items.quote: It's around -- planned to be around INR53 crores.

items.statement: Good order position in Q1 for LatAm exports but recovery depends on liquidation of shipped materials
items.quote: We have good order position in the first quarter, but we still have to have a little bit long-term view as to how this will pan out.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 gross margin of 42% considered sustainable at normalized levels, not driven by one-time positives
items.quote: So we are not saying or we feel that there are no extraordinary onetime positive events but there was one extraordinary negative event, which is past us.

items.statement: Raw material prices not expected to sharply increase barring geopolitical supply chain disruptions
items.quote: I don't think that the prices are likely to sharply increase or go up again, vis-a-vis the caveat that geopolitical situation is -- you are aware, is quite dicey.

items.statement: Domestic demand sentiment slightly better than last year but farmers waiting on monsoon and pricing outlook
items.quote: Compared to last year, the sentiments are good. The monsoon forecast is good. So there is not a significant pushback but it's also there is not a significant demand.

items.statement: Three 9(3) proprietary products launching in Kharif FY25; 1-2 more pending regulatory approval
items.quote: All these 3 products are 9(3) proprietary products, unique combinations, which will be coming into the market in the next few weeks, targeting the Kharif season.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk: Taiwan route closure could disrupt China supply chain, increasing transport cost and lead time
items.quote: Suppose if the Taiwan route closes down, the supply chain will be totally disrupted. And China will have to find a very long way of sort of a sea route to get the materials.

items.statement: Dahej site land in possession; EC application filed with broad product list; final product approval from Japan pending; commercial production 18-24 months after EC
items.quote: As soon as the environment clearance comes, as soon as the SCC Japan approves the list of products, we are ready to start the activities at Dahej site.

items.statement: Bhavnagar 30-acre expansion land vacant; tebuconazole capacity addition of 1,000 tons per annum ready to replicate when demand clarity emerges
items.quote: This plot was taken to expand our tebuconazole facility because as you know, as we already have one plant of tebuconazole at Bhavnagar.

items.statement: All future capex including Dahej to be funded from internal accruals; no external borrowing planned
items.quote: We are in a position to make that capex from our internal accruals. We are not going to borrow any money from outside for this capex.

items.statement: Green energy capex of ~INR25 crores to achieve 100% captive power by end of FY25, saving ~2 crore units at INR4/unit
items.quote: We want to be 100% green power generation company by the end of this financial year. So we have some capex for that. I think there's -- that itself is around INR25 crores for the green energy.

items.statement: Bhavnagar specialty plant first project at 40-60% commercialization in FY24, targeting 100% in FY25; second project revenues starting FY25/FY26
items.quote: The first project was already commissioned last year and it has started the commercial revenue not to the extent of 100% but maybe say, you can say between 40% to 60% commercialization we have achieved last year.

items.statement: LatAm export recovery gradual and back-ended to FY26; dependent on inventory liquidation and weather
items.quote: So from an overall full year perspective, export full recovery is more back-ended more FY '26 than in FY '25, which is again volume-led.

items.statement: Core operating revenue expected to grow at 20% CAGR over next 2 years backed by ongoing contracts
items.quote: So on the core operating front which is excluding IndAS looking at our tipping fee and sale of RDF we would be in the range of around 20% growth over the next 2 years backed fully by ongoing contracts.

items.statement: Core EBITDA margin expected in 22-24% range going forward
items.quote: EBITDA margins will be in the range of around 22% to 24%.

items.statement: PAT margin expected around 10.5% to 11.25% going forward
items.quote: So we would be happy with the PAT margin of around 10.5% to 11.25% going forward.

items.statement: Tyre recycling project capex estimated at INR5-7 crores
items.quote: Tires also is going to be in the range of INR5 -INR6 crores, I mean, depending on how we proceed because we are going to import tires as well to make the project viable for some of the end applications.

items.statement: Chennai waste processing tender for 3,000-4,000 TPD with 1,400 TPD WTE and 300 TPD biomining, proposal submission in July
items.quote: So there is one ongoing tender which we are very seriously pursuing in the city of Chennai. I would not say it's just as a waste-to-energy because that's a very large waste processing you can say park which they have contemplated.

items.statement: CIDCO biomining contract worth INR77 crores to process 8.6 lakh tons legacy waste over 2 years, commercial operations starting Q1 FY25
items.quote: Another new project in the processing phase was the company securing a biomining contract in CIDCO valued at approximately INR77 crores in which the company will process about 8.6 lakh tons of legacy waste over 2 years.

items.statement: Panvel C&T contract worth INR386 crores, asset-light model with municipality procuring infrastructure
items.quote: Among these, the company signed a contract worth approximately INR386 crores for its collection and transportation projects of municipal solid waste in Panvel Municipal Corporation.

items.statement: PCMC WTE plant achieved 71% PLF in inaugural quarter, targeting 80% stabilization
items.quote: The plant is running successfully since then and achieved an impressive plant-load factor of approximately 71% during its inaugural first quarter of operation. This marks a significant milestone, and the company aims to stabilize their performance at about 80% going forward.

items.statement: PCMC WTE incremental revenue expected INR45-55 crores annually from tipping fee and power sales
items.quote: So normally, based on the tipping fee and the rate at which the power is sold, we would be looking at anywhere in the range of INR45 crores to INR55 crores depending upon the tonnage flows and everything.

items.statement: C&D plant Mumbai annualized revenue INR30 crores, commissioning in June
items.quote: That would be about INR30-odd crores in the first full year.

items.statement: CIDCO biomining revenue expected INR35-40 crores this year (10 months)
items.quote: This year, I think we should do about INR35 crores to INR40 crores.

items.statement: Panvel C&T revenue expected INR35-36 crores annually
items.quote: Panvel would be about INR35 crores to INR36 crores.

items.statement: Post-election period expected to bring increased tender activity from July-August
items.quote: Furthermore, with the elections behind us by the first half of the year, we expect to see positive traction in the announcement of new tenders.

items.statement: Income tax search claim of INR9 crores (9% of FY24 profit) being contested via CIT appeal
items.quote: We have received a total claim from the authority amounting to INR9 crores. This represents about 9% of our annual profit for FY '24. Our dedicated team is diligently planning to contest this claim through CIT appeal.

items.statement: Group debt at INR414.6 crores, net debt INR343 crores, net debt/equity 0.5x, debt-free in 4 years without new contracts
items.quote: As of March '24, the company's group debt stood at INR414.6 crores and net debt is at around INR343 crores indicating net debt to equity of around 0.5x.

items.statement: FY25 order inflow target INR15,000-20,000 crores
items.quote: In FY'25, we will target at least INR15,000-INR20,000 crores.

items.statement: FY25 revenue expected to remain flattish
items.quote: This year it will remain flattish.

items.statement: FY26 revenue growth target 15-20%
items.quote: For FY26 we are targeting a growth of 15% to 20% which is achievable.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin expected around 13.5%
items.quote: Yes 13.5 around that.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expected to increase from FY25
items.quote: This year it will remain the same and next year it will definitely increase.

items.statement: Order book INR16,781 crores with executable INR9,735 crores as of March 31, 2024
items.quote: As on 31st March '24, value of order book stood at INR16,781 crores out of which INR9,735 crores are executable order book.

items.statement: L1 for two EPC road projects in Maharashtra worth INR4,346 crores in May 2024
items.quote: In the month of May 2024, the company has also emerged as the lowest bidder for the two EPC road projects in the state of Maharashtra worth INR4,346 crores.

items.statement: Submitted bids for 12 highway and railway projects worth INR10,228 crores awaiting opening
items.quote: As on date, the company has submitted 12 highway and railway projects bids amounting to INR10,228 crores which are expected to be opened soon.

items.statement: FY25 capex target INR200-250 crores including INR100-150 crores for office building
items.quote: We are targeting around INR200 crores to INR250-odd crores for the current year reason being INR100 crores will be -- INR150 crores, we will be putting in our office building.

items.statement: FY24 capex was INR108 crores
items.quote: During the year, company has made addition to the fixed asset amount of INR108 crores.

items.statement: Promoter equity contribution INR2,137 crores balance for HAM projects, expecting INR800-850 crores in FY25
items.quote: Balance promoter contribution or equity contribution required to be made for our operational or yet to start HAM project is INR2,137 crores, of which we are expecting contribution of INR800 crores to INR850 crores in the current financial year.

items.statement: Belgaum bypass HAM project (INR797 crores) terminated due to authority non-fulfilment
items.quote: One of our HEM projects, Belgavi bypass in the state of Karnataka having EPC value worth INR797 crores has been terminated due to non-fulfilment of condition presented by authority.

items.statement: Ludhiana-Rupnagar HAM project (INR750 crores EPC) termination communicated due to land unavailability, 15-17% executed
items.quote: NSA has not been able to provide requisite index-free ROW for construction work in one of our HEM projects in the state of Punjab and hence we have communicated our intention to terminate the project.

items.statement: Targeting order pipeline worth INR250,000 crores across highways, tunnels, metro, power transmission, railways
items.quote: The company is targeting order pipeline worth INR250,000 crores in various sectors like highway, road tunnels, metro, power and transmission, railways and roadways, etcetera.

items.statement: FY25 order inflow mix: 50% HAM, 25% EPC, 20% BOT, 5% non-road (metro, tunnel, power transmission)
items.quote: If we categorize it separately 50% will be HAM, 25% will be EPC and 20% will be BOT.

items.statement: Transferred 7 operational HAM assets to Bharat Highways InvIT for 43.56% stake, gain INR1,372 crores, debt reduced INR3,533 crores
items.quote: During the quarter, the company has transferred 7 operational HEM assets to Bharat Highways InvIT in exchange of units in the InvIT which resulted into 43.56% stake in the InvIT. The result gained on the transaction has been shown as an exceptional item in financial statements.

items.statement: Management targets minimum 30% revenue growth for FY25, with potential to exceed if exports pick up
items.quote: So, financially, for FY '25, we are looking at a minimum of 30% growth, sir, to drive that. So, that is what we are looking at the minimum number to drive that. And we will hopefully drive much higher than that.

items.statement: Maximum capital expenditure has been incurred; new R&D setup and additional line of activity completed
items.quote: Now that the maximum capital expenditure has been incurred. We are confident that our capital expenditure will be beneficial for us in the forthcoming period and our margins may increase positively impacting our net profitability.

items.statement: PAT margin decreased from 30.28% to 27.22% due to higher depreciation from new R&D setup; EBITDA margin fell from 41.69% to 38.30% due to marketing, exhibition, employee costs
items.quote: Those are PAT margin decreased from 30.28% in the financial year 2022-23 to 27.22% in the financial year 2023 -24. This reduction is due to an increase in depreciation and other expenses relative to revenue impacting net profitability, but depreciation is directly linked to our new R&D setup and additional line of activity.

items.statement: Domestic sales grew 26.47% in FY24; Oradox oral care range showing promising response; 3D resin sales growing positively in India and abroad
items.quote: Let me begin by highlighting our domestic sales growth which has surged by an impressive 26.47% in the current financial year compared to the preceding year.

items.statement: Oradox oral care brand launched with specialty mouthwashes, serums, tablets; disinfectant line ready for commercial launch; 3D printing resins gaining traction
items.quote: Our new segment oral care under the brand name Oradox has shown promising response since its inception. The positive r esponse from our stakeholders reaffirms our confidence that Oradox will significantly contribute to our top line in the post-semi-period.

items.statement: Export growth 5% in FY24; US share grew from 2.87% to 3.6%; major challenges in African and South American countries due to currency constraints
items.quote: There was about 5% growth in the exports in this financial year, in the last financial year.

items.statement: Export challenges in African and South American countries due to foreign exchange shortages; European recession from Russia-Ukraine war impacting some markets
items.quote: The major challenges we are facing for the exports are in some African countries and South American countries. So, these are the two continents where we have not been able to grow. But we have been able to maintain the same level of exports.

items.statement: Company holds cash reserves (INR28-48 crores) and evaluating inorganic growth opportunities including acquisitions outside India
items.quote: We are looking at different opportunities, options to invest with this cash reserve. So we are looking at opportunity to invest or acquire some companies so that we can have some inorganic growth.

items.statement: Export margins approximately 10-12% higher than domestic margins due to higher international pricing
items.quote: Yes, yes. Approximately about 10%-12% difference.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 45% with 55% unutilized capacity; R&D centre approved by Ministry of Science and Technology; 17 academic institution tie-ups
items.quote: Our current capacity utilization stands at 45% for the existing product line, indicating that we still have 55% unutilized capacity.

items.statement: North and West regions grew ~10% YoY in Q4; UP, Bihar, Maharashtra improved 20%, 14%, 10% respectively; rural demand subdued in Q2-Q3 but portfolio optimization from Rs 799-2,999 addressing gaps
items.quote: So during the quarter, right, so we've seen increase in our North and West business by almost like a 10% increase year-on-year. And the other regions have sort of been flattish, like East and Central and South have more or less been flat.

items.statement: Premiumization slowed; pivoting to economical portfolio (Rs 899-1,000 MRP) to drive volume and operating leverage; ASP may not grow at same pace but offset by higher volumes
items.quote: So therefore, we've pivoted to the strategy of increasing our economical portfolio as well. That is from 899, basically up to 1000 bucks MRP. So that would definitely give us additional volume. And any margin there would be compensated by additional volume from and create operating leverage.

items.statement: Aspire to maintain EBITDA margins 17%-19%; Q4 FY24 delivered 18.3%; A&P spend to continue at 6%-7% of revenue
items.quote: So going forward, certainly we'll aspire to maintain our margins in the range of, | would say, 17% to 19% EBITDA levels that is the aspiration, and even in this quarter four, we've delivered at 18.3

items.statement: Plan to open 80-100 EBOs per year from FY25 onwards, mostly FOFO; maintain ~75:25 FOFO:COCO ratio
items.quote: But going forward, as we see better visibility and | would say, BIS impact also coming in, we would certainly like to get back on track in terms of opening about 80 to 100 stores from FY25 onwards again, most of which would be FOFO

items.statement: BIS norms require non-BIS inventory upload by Aug 1, 2024 and liquidation by June 1, 2025; importers loaded inventory early; green shoots from import decline expected in 2-3 quarters
items.quote: But because the BIS norms dictate that we need to upload the non- BIS inventory onto the portal by 1st of August this year, and the government has given time till 1st of June 2025 to liquidate all non-BIS goods, therefore we believe that a lot of, | would say, importers did some loading of inventory early on

items.statement: Channel inventory fairly in control; only 1-2 areas slightly elevated but not concerning
items.quote: It is fairly in control. We don't see barring maybe just one or two areas, which is not very concerning. We are fairly comfortable in terms of channel inventory at the moment.

items.statement: Complete portfolio segregation across channels: online/offline separate, EBO common, LFS specific; added open category (sandals, slippers, school shoes) for seasonality
items.quote: So portfolio is specific to each channel. So we don't have a common portfolio anymore. There is no conflict, especially between the online and GTM, between GT. So there is a complete segregation of portfolio across all price points between both the channels.

items.statement: Trade distribution grew 7.5% YoY in Q4; D2C declined 6% (B2B/O2O down 55%, marketplace up 32%); net value growth ~4.7%; D2C offline (COCO/FOFO/LFS) grew 30-40%+
items.quote: So we've seen about 7.5% growth in terms of value in our trade channels in Quarter 4. And this is primarily due to these two or three initiatives that we have quite aggressively run.

items.statement: Paid off Rs 156.5 cr debt in FY24; achieved net debt-free status; highest ever net operating cash flow Rs 264.5 cr; working capital cycle reduced from 108 to 79 days
items.quote: The company paid off debts amounting to Rs. 156.5 crores in FY24, reaching a net debt-free status during the year. It gives me immense pleasure to share that Campus Activewear generated the highest ever net operating cash flow of Rs. 264.5 crores in FY24.

items.statement: No numeric guidance given; aspire to maintain/grow business from current levels; confident of double-digit then mid-teen growth if macros stable
items.quote: So we do have a good visibility in terms of getting there sooner than later. The only question remains again is in terms of macros, as long as they remain stable and not too volatile or too depressed, right? | don't see really much of a challenge from here on, given the new strategy that we've pivoted to

items.statement: Non-Par share of individual APE more than doubled to 18.32% in FY24 from 8.89% in FY23
items.quote: Further, the welcome reception by our customers to our new Non Par products such as Jeevan Utsav has added strength and confidence to our belief that our strategy is on Life Insurance Corporation of India May 28, 2024 right track

items.statement: Target Banca channel share to grow to 5-6% from current 3.61% in FY25
items.quote: We want to grow at least 5-6% from present 3.61% share of Banca to total our business. So, that will grow at least 5%, 6%. That is our target for Banca.

items.statement: VNB margin expanded 60 bps to 16.8% in FY24 despite PAR and group margin pressure
items.quote: Further, the net VNB margin for FY24 is 16.8% as compared to 16.2% for year ended March 31st 2023. Hence, the VNB margin has expanded by 60 basis points on a year on year basis.

items.statement: Agency transformation project Jeevan Samarth launched to strengthen Tier-2, Tier-3 and rural presence
items.quote: This year we have also taken one project, Agency Transformation Project for the current year. We call it Jeevan Samarth. So, that is just started.

items.statement: Target at least one LIC agent in every panchayat in FY25 to deepen rural penetration
items.quote: This year we have taken a target; we should represent every panchayat. Every panchayat in the country must have one LIC agent at least. So, that is the target for the current year.

items.statement: Excess expense of management of Rs 5,477 crore for FY24 and Rs 7,230 crore for FY23 to be amortized over 3 years from FY25
items.quote: Note number 10 provides for excess of expense of management of 5,477 crore for '23-'24. And both these expenses will be amortized over a period of 3 years starting from '24-'25.

items.statement: Six new Non-Par products launched in FY24 including Jeevan Kiran, Jeevan Utsav, Jeevan Dhara-II, Dhan Vriddhi, Index Plus and Amritbaal
items.quote: Continuing with our strategy of increasing the proportion of the Non par business, we launched six new Non par products during FY 2023-24 to cater to customer requirements, namely, LIC's Jeevan Kiran, LIC's Jeevan Utsav, LIC's Jeevan Dhara - II, LIC's Dhan Vriddhi, LIC's Index Plus and LIC's Amritbaal, respectively.

items.statement: PAR and group VNB margins declined due to falling risk-free rates and annuity benefit enhancements
items.quote: As regards the margins, yes, the margins under PAR and group had fallen mainly because of the movement in the risk-free rates. And in the case of group, the benefit enhancement done in the annuities is the major cause of it.

items.statement: Regulatory discussions ongoing on surrender regulations and trail commission model; no final outcome yet
items.quote: So far as this regulation is concerned, we as insurance companies, we have placed before regulator our views. Discussion is going on. Some final outcome will come which will be in the best interest of customers as well as industry.

items.statement: Surplus distribution to shareholders in PAR business increased from 7.5% to 10% from FY25
items.quote: From this year onwards. From '24-'25, it will get increased.

items.statement: Protection APE including riders grew ~6% to ~Rs 201 crore in FY24; working on more term product variants for FY25
items.quote: If we include the rider premium for the current year and last year, it's a Non-PAR protection would be around 201 APE would be there as compared to 190 last year. So, almost 6% growth would be observed there.

items.statement: Digital transformation to be experienced by stakeholders before end of calendar year 2024
items.quote: We are moving ahead steadily on our digital transformation project and I hope that before the end of this calendar year, our stakeholders start experiencing the changes in our digital transformation.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of Rs 6 per share for FY24 in addition to Rs 4 interim dividend
items.quote: I would like to share that the Board has recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 6/- per share in its meeting held on 27th May, 2024, subject to shareholders approval. This is in addition to Rs. 4/- per share interim dividend that was declared and paid earlier during the year.

items.statement: Revenue estimated to grow at approximate 20% CAGR for next 3 years with Gross Margins maintained in 11% to 13% range
items.quote: Given the macro development of the credit card industry, the higher base of the business model and ever -changing industry scenario, we estimate that our Revenues would grow at an approximate 20% CAGR for the next 3 years and maintain Gross Margins in the range of 11% to 13%.

items.statement: Full year FY24 Gross Margin at 12.1% in line with 11%-13% guidance; Q4 FY24 Gross Margin at 12.5%
items.quote: For the full year, our Gross Margins were at 12.1%, in line with the guidance of 11% -13%.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin improved quarter-on-quarter from 7.4% in Q1 to 9.7% in Q4 FY24, up 226 basis points
items.quote: On a quarter-on-quarter basis, driven by our concentrated focus on improving operational efficiencies, innovations and collaborations, we have been increasing our Adjusted EBITDA margins from 7.4% in Q1 to 9.7% in Q4, up by 226 basis points.

items.statement: Services other than India airport lounge now contribute 6% of revenue, up from <2% in FY22; expect 15%-20% contribution in next 4-5 years
items.quote: The services other than the Indian airport lounge now contribute 6% to our Revenue, which was less than 2% in FY22. We remain focused on increasing the contribution of these services and expect these services to contribute around 15% to 20% in the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: Credit card industry structural shift to spend-based benefits implemented in Q3 FY24; revenue growth was 47% vs potential 65% without the model change; impact expected to stabilize by Q3 FY25
items.quote: We have been addressing the ongoing structural changes in the credit card industry whereas the card issuers are moving to a spend-based benefit structure instead of a blanket card benefit. This change was implemented in Q3 of this year, and we will continue to see the changes across the providers until the spend-based system is in place. This structural shift in the model meant that our revenue gr

items.statement: Volume impact from spend-based programs ongoing in Q1 and Q2 FY25; expected to stabilize by Q3 FY25
items.quote: In the coming quarter, we see that 2 or 3 large clients, we have already got the dates in terms of the spend -based solution that they have adopted, and we are still yet to see the volumes that will get impacted. To my mind, I think we will see through this in Q3 probably. So, the volume will stabilize in Q3.

items.statement: No major capex disclosed; asset-light model maintained; cash and equivalents INR101 crores; net worth up 50% to INR236 crores
items.quote: We continue to have a strong balance sheet with our Net Worth up by 50% to INR236 crores compared to last year. Our Cash and Cash Equivalents balance as at quarter end stood at INR101 crores.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR1.5 per share for FY24; with interim dividend of INR0.50 in Q1 FY24, annual dividend equals 100% of face value
items.quote: Further, I'm happy to share with you that our Board has recommended a final dividend of INR1.5 per share for FY24. We had paid an interim dividend of INR0.50 in Q1FY24, which takes our annual dividend to 100% of the face value.

items.statement: Global lounge partnerships with Plaza Premium and Grey Wall expanding international network; Singapore office established with senior hire to target Southeast Asia market
items.quote: In global, we are in process of adding more and more lounges and different touchpoints. When we say touch points, it would be meet and assist, the airport transfer, the spas and the F&B outlets as well.

items.statement: Railway lounge business grew 3.5x in FY24; 100% coverage maintained across 14 railway lounges
items.quote: Our Railway Lounge business has also witnessed a robust growth and has grown by 3.5x in FY24 from the previous year. We continue to maintain 100% coverage in railway lounges as well, with the presence of 14 railway lounges across India.

items.statement: Highway lounge aggregation initiated with 2 lounges; expect significant growth over 5-10 years driven by EV charging infrastructure
items.quote: In fact, we have already added someone from the South, a company who currently has aggregated only 2 lounges. However, I do not want to really dilute it by saying that it is two lounges, considering that in the coming 10 years, we will see a lot of electric vehicles on the road. And because of which the number of lounges on the highway will increase.

items.statement: Global lounge commercials not yet at par with India rates; expect to achieve similar commercials as volumes build
items.quote: In terms of the pricing, I would say that it was not in line with what we have in the India market. Of course, in India market, we enjoy the best of the commercial s because of the volume, what we drive there. And subsequently, it will take time for us in the global market also to enjoy the similar type of commercials.

items.statement: Non-lounge services carry higher margins than airport lounge hero product
